maintenance_led.reason: Sells PYLARIFY, DEFINITY and Flyrcado imaging agents used per patient scan, not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Radiopharmaceutical diagnostics sold to imaging centers and hospitals, paid by mixed Medicare, commercial insurers and other payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own drug products like PYLARIFY and pipeline; Progenics merger and in-licensing are occasional deals.

mission_critical.reason: Imaging centers can switch to competing PSMA PET or ultrasound contrast agents without major disruption.

notes: Payer mix (Medicare share) and switching costs for regulated diagnostic agents are uncertain.
